Name: TheGreatMamoose's Portraits - Downhill Project
Author: TheGreatMamoose
Description:
This is my take on the portraits for Arthur, Father Anderson, and Julia from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872]Downhill Project[/url]. Each character has a full set of dialogue expressions and outfits for all four seasons.

Thank you to Kiyugamods for giving me permission to make and share my own version of the Downhill portraits, and to Kiyuga and Vlgor for creating the original art. I really appreciate their work and the chance to make something for their characters.

[b]Requirements[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.10 or newer, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9.0 or newer, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872]Downhill Project[/url] with its requirements. Install the requirements separately.

[b]Installation[/b]
1. Install the requirements above and close the game. If you’re updating, remove the older copy of this portrait pack first.
2. Choose one install method:
[b]Vortex:[/b] On the Files tab, choose [b]Mod manager download[/b]. In Vortex, install, enable, and deploy the mod.
[b]Manual:[/b] On the Files tab, choose [b]Manual download[/b] and extract the ZIP into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. Keep the [CP] TheGreatMamoose Portraits - Downhill folder together with its manifest.json, content.json, and assets.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

To uninstall, close the game. If you used Vortex, remove the mod in Vortex and deploy your changes. If you installed manually, remove [CP] TheGreatMamoose Portraits - Downhill from Mods.

[b]Outfits and compatibility[/b]
The pack replaces dialogue portraits. Downhill still supplies the characters, walking sprites, and dialogue. The winter portrait follows Downhill’s winter sprite selection. Festivals use the regular seasonal portraits. Use one portrait pack for these three characters at a time.

[b]Support[/b]
If a portrait is missing or looks wrong, include the character, season or event, game and dependency versions, a screenshot, other portrait mods you’re using, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url].

[b]Credits and artwork[/b]
TheGreatMamoose — portrait pack and pixel edits. Kiyugamods — Downhill Project. Kiyuga and Vlgor — original artwork. ConcernedApe — Stardew Valley. Pathoschild and contributors — SMAPI and Content Patcher.

I used OpenAI image generation for the portrait bases and outfit concepts, then edited them pixel by pixel and fitted them to the original expressions and poses. I used Downhill Project’s portraits and sprites as character references, and an image from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21741?tab=images]Veronnica’s portrait gallery[/url] as a style reference.
